metadata.title: Compact Proof of the Positivity of Quasi-Local Masses for a class of Initial Data
metadata.abstract: We prove a purely quasi-local positivity theorem for the Wang--Yau mass for a class of initial data whose Jang deformation, after a boundary-preserving conformal reduction to zero scalar curvature, lies in a sufficiently small transverse--traceless (TT) perturbative neighborhood of a strictly convex Euclidean this http URL explicitly construct a nontrivial class of physical initial data whose admissible Jang reductions realize this TT-generated sector. The argument reduces the Wang--Yau energy to the Brown--York mass of the resulting scalar-flat compact metric, together with nonnegative bulk terms determined by the Jang deformation, and establishes strict positivity by computing the second variation of the Brown--York functional at the Euclidean metric in transverse--traceless directions. The proof is entirely confined to the compact fill-in and uses neither an asymptotically flat extension nor the positive mass theorem. This gives a partial answer to a question of R. Schoen concerning a genuinely quasi-local proof of positivity for quasi-local mass.

analysis.workSummary: 对 Jang 变形经保边共形化后处于严格凸欧氏模型附近小 TT 扰动类的初始数据，给出纯拟局部 Wang–Yau 质量正性证明，并构造实现该类的数据。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明只在紧填充内部进行，不借助渐近平坦延拓或正质量定理，对 Schoen 的问题给出部分回答。
analysis.limitations: 结论是受限小扰动初始数据类，不是任意初始数据的拟局部正质量定理；网页摘要含链接占位文本，精确条件应查正文。 数学解读仅依据官方摘要与作者评论，尚未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索与命中核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。
